segments.text: Here's what's new in reader, the open-source feed reader.
YouTube has no feed for your subscriptions, so reader imports them from a Google Takeout export.
Private feeds can sign in with a password, a token, or OAuth.
Podcasts play right in the reader.
Chapters and transcripts jump the player to that moment.
And YouTube channels read well as a pinboard.
